value.thought: The student wants to know why Docker is important for their ML engineer path. I will explain the relevance of Docker based on its job market demand and how it fits into their learning roadmap.
value.answer: Docker is important because 41% of ML engineer job ads mention it, and its demand is rising. It helps you package your code and its environment so it runs reliably anywhere, which is key for deploying machine learning models. Although your degree doesn't cover it, learning Docker now will boost your readiness and job prospects. This week's focus on Docker is designed to build this crucial skill step-by-step.
